may_change_without_invalidating_model_te: bug fixes that do not alter historical/current decisions and are versioned
additional diagnostics that do not feed decisions
quarterly_metrics: factor alpha regressions with caveat on low n

2029_reasonable_evidence_rule.full_alpha_rank_ic_mean: >0 and positive in >=55% of forward months is favorable
2029_reasonable_evidence_rule.ff5_mom_alpha: >0; HAC t-stat >=1.5 encouraging and >=2.0 materially stronger, recognizing 36 months is a short sample
2029_reasonable_evidence_rule.drawdown: must remain within the predeclared risk mandate; no ex-post threshold change
2029_reasonable_evidence_rule.benchmark_robustness: positive active evidence vs SPY plus at least one of RSP/QQQ over the same period
2029_reasonable_evidence_rule.failure_rule: If 36-month net active CAGR <=0 and mean forward IC <=0, the alpha hypothesis has failed its first serious forward hurdle. Continue observation only as research; do not retune and relabel the same test.
